title: SUNDAY MOBILITY
subtitle: SUNDAY. MOBILITY, STILL BARKED. GLUTE BRIDGES, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, CAT-COW, FIGURE-FOUR, WALL CHEST OPENER, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH. LOOSE, NOT LAZY.

script.welcome: RISE AND SHINE, SUNDAY SLUGABED. MOBILITY DAY. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. GLUTE BRIDGES TO WAKE THE BACKSIDE, A BALANCE TEST, THEN WE OPEN THE SPINE, THE HIPS AND THE CHEST. STRETCHING IS NOT A NAP WITH EXTRA STEPS, SO DO NOT GET COSY ON THAT FLOOR. SLOW BREATHING. PROPER FORM. MOVE.
script.rest: REST. LONG BREATH IN THROUGH THE NOSE, OUT THROUGH THE MOUTH. NO, YOU MAY NOT CHECK THE FOOTBALL SCORES.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. MAKE IT YOUR BEST. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SPINE MOBILE, HIPS OPEN, CHEST UNFOLDED, BALANCE TESTED. THAT IS HOW A MAN STAYS NIMBLE INTO HIS EIGHTIES. TOMORROW IS LEGS, AND TOMORROW IS WEIGH IN. GO EASY ON THE SUNDAY ROAST, YOU GREEDY SOD.
script.pause: HOLD. DO NOT FALL ASLEEP DOWN THERE.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGES (SLOW, PAUSE AT TOP)
exercises.cue: LIE ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT, FEET FLAT HIP-WIDTH, ARMS BY YOUR SIDES. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT THE HIPS UNTIL KNEES, HIPS AND SHOULDERS MAKE A LINE. PAUSE TWO SECONDS AT THE TOP, LOWER SLOWLY. RIBS DOWN, NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO ROUNDS. TEN REPS. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE AND LIFT. PAUSE AT THE TOP. LOWER SLOW. THAT BACKSIDE HAS BEEN SAT ON ALL WEEK. TIME IT EARNED ITS KEEP.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. STAY DOWN. BREATHE. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK, LEVEL WITH THE BODY. HOLD THREE SECONDS, RETURN WITH CONTROL, SWITCH. HIPS SQUARE TO THE FLOOR. SLOW BEATS HIGH.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM, OPPOSITE LEG. HOLD THREE. BACK SLOW. HIPS SQUARE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. WOBBLE IF YOU MUST, BUT DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON A BARSTOOL.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON HANDS AND KNEES. BREATHE IN, DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAILBONE (COW). BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK, TUCK THE CHIN AND TAIL (CAT). MOVE ONE VERTEBRA AT A TIME. SLOW, WITH THE BREATH.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. EIGHT SLOW ONES. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK. MOVE WITH THE BREATH. YOUR SPINE IS A CHAIN, NOT A BLOODY PLANK OF WOOD.
exercises.speakDone: CAT COW DONE. BACK LOOSER. GOOD.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP STRETCH
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. THREAD YOUR HANDS BEHIND THE BOTTOM THIGH AND DRAW IT GENTLY TOWARD YOU UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTSIDE OF THE HIP. HEAD AND SHOULDERS DOWN. HOLD THIRTY, SWITCH. CHAIR VERSION IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE. DRAW IT IN GENTLE. HEAD DOWN. BREATHE INTO THE HIP. THOSE HIPS ARE RUSTIER THAN A NAAFI TEA URN.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO A WALL. FOREARM ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, BENT NINETY DEGREES. STEP THROUGH AND TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, NO SHRUG. HOLD THIRTY, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. STEP THROUGH. TURN AWAY. SHOULDER DOWN. UNDO A WEEK OF HUNCHING OVER THAT KEYBOARD LIKE A GOBLIN.

exercises.name: HALF-KNEELING HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEEL, BACK KNEE ON A CUSHION, FRONT FOOT FLAT. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE, EASE THE HIPS FORWARD. FOR A SUNDAY BONUS, REACH THE ARM ON THE KNEELING SIDE UP AND GENTLY TWIST TOWARD THE FRONT LEG. TALL CHEST. HOLD THIRTY, SWITCH. HAND ON A CHAIR IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. HALF KNEEL. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. TUCK THE TAIL. SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE. EASE FORWARD. REACH UP AND TWIST GENTLE TOWARD THE FRONT LEG. TALL CHEST. LAST ONE, THEN YOU CAN GO BACK TO YOUR SUNDAY PAPER.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
